biological_meaning: summed length of the MANE Select CDS features in nucleotides, excluding the stop codon
exact_formula: cds_length = sum(MANE Select CDS feature spans) - 3. This annotation set's CDS features INCLUDE the stop codon - summed CDS equals 3 x protein_length + 3 for 19292 of 19293 transcripts, and the separately annotated stop_codon feature lies INSIDE a CDS interval in all 3989 sampled transcripts, never outside. Omitting the -3 would inflate every value by exactly 3. NA in two enumerated cases: the 70 non-coding MANE Select transcripts with no CDS feature (45 lncRNA, 23 snRNA, 1 ribozyme, 1 snoRNA, the same 70 rows whose Ensembl_prot is empty), and ENST00000434431.2, which has CDS but no annotated stop codon and a CDS sum not divisible by three. Sourced from the MANE GFF rather than from the gnomAD table even though v4.1 offers a cds_length column, so the value is tied to the pinned transcript annotation and does not move when the constraint release changes.
